niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, well-structured interfaces that feel complete and easy to scan, with clear section separation, strong hierarchy, and enough visible content to feel useful. They like concise, direct copy, prominent and obvious actions, and polished app-like presentation. They generally favor light themes in settings/onboarding contexts, but prefer dark, focused modal/alert surfaces when the task is a high-stakes confirmation or warning.

criteria.description: Multiple clearly separated sections or cards with strong grouping and easy-to-scan organization.
More settings or entries visible at once, with less empty space and fewer sparse or blank areas.
A screen that feels fully populated, evenly distributed, and visually finished rather than top-heavy or unfinished.
Short, straightforward, low-verbosity text that gets to the point quickly.
Obvious, prominent controls and buttons with strong affordance and easy drill-down or next-step cues.
Clear headline emphasis, a single focal point, and reduced competition between elements.
A cohesive, intentional, premium-looking interface that feels designed rather than placeholder-like or fragmented.
